styleSelection.reason: The reference is pure watercolor: broad transparent washes and selected painted edges carry the ship; no ink structure is present.

families.referenceCue: The large blue-grey vessel curves from the upper centre into a deep lower contact; preserve one rounded body and let its value planes turn with the hull.
Pale warm sail and sheet shapes remain open behind the hull, with only a few firm overlaps and dark fittings at upper right.
A cropped cool vessel and a few ochre spars cross at the left; join the dark overlap and reserve the warm spars for sparse accents.
A turquoise water band opens to the right and deepens along the lower edge; keep it one broad field with broken, non-repeating lights.
